title: Refrigerante de limão fermentado
creator: lari.soaresr

items.note: very large, or 150 ml juice, plus all the peels

steps: Sanitise the lemons (soak 10 minutes in 1 tbsp bleach per litre of water, then rinse well).
Peel them and put the juice, peels, sugar and water in a glass jar. Close it, and once a day open, stir and close again for 3 days, away from sunlight.
Dissolve the sugar in warm water, let it cool, then add 250 ml of the starter and the lemon juice.
Pour into PET bottles, squeeze out the air and close. It's ready when the bottles swell, in 3–5 days depending on the temperature.
Keep the starter in the fridge and feed it once a week with water, lemon juice and sugar in the proportions above.
notes: She measured 0.46% alcohol, which counts as non-alcoholic in Brazil.
